schema.name: USG Sketch Interpretation Record + Neutral Building Specification
schema.description: Machine-readable reconstruction of Building 001 from one hand-sketch sheet (plan + perspective). It separates binding evidence from observations, approximations, ambiguities, and unknowns so an AI can reproduce the same interpretation in different authoring tools without silently inventing design facts.

evidence_classes.exact: Explicit dimension or literal source fact. Binding.
evidence_classes.derived: Arithmetic or geometric consequence of exact evidence. Binding while premises remain true.
evidence_classes.observed: Presence, host, topology, or relation visible in the source. Metric value is not binding unless separately exact/derived.
evidence_classes.approximate: Proportional or visualization estimate. May be used only in a declared concept/visualization mode.
evidence_classes.ambiguous: Two or more materially different readings remain plausible.
evidence_classes.unknown: Not resolved by the source. Must remain null in authoritative data.
evidence_classes.convention: Coordinate or adapter convention introduced only to make reconstruction reproducible; never treated as source evidence.

schema.governing_rule: Dimensions override proportion. Proportion fills the gaps. User clarification resolves contradictions.

project.name: Sketch Building 001
project.source: Hand sketch dated 2026-10-26, plan and perspective on one sheet

authoritative_geometry.line_meaning: One sketched stroke. Not known to be outside face, centreline, or finish face.

footprint_polygon.note: Every coordinate is dimensioned or derived. The 0.9 is only the colinearity at x = 8000.

footprint_area_m2.note: Gross area inside the sketched stroke. Not a net room area.

footprint_edges.on_sketch: bottom of the upper bar, beside the open corner

assumptions.statement: Use 2700 mm wall height for visualization.
Use 200 mm exterior-wall thickness, offset inward from the authoritative footprint boundary.
Use 120 mm internal-partition thickness centered on partition paths.
Use 150 mm slab thickness with slab top at z=0 and thickness downward.
Use x=4500 mm for the left-room partition.
Use y=2700 mm from the sketch top for the bath/kitchen split.
Use 27 degrees for the primary gable pitch.
Use 24 degrees for the projecting-wing gable pitch.

withdrawn_assumptions.statement: v0.1 treated the right-hand 14.0 m as an interpretation.
withdrawn_assumptions.why_withdrawn: The digit is written, in the same hand as the top dimension.

unknowns: whether the sketched stroke is outside face, centreline, or finish face
whether IP_DERIVED_02 is solid or interrupted
which short end D_GABLE_01 is on
window counts, widths, heights, and positions along their host walls
correspondence between perspective windows and plan ticks
meaning of the rectangle in the kitchen
whether a hall was simply not drawn
exact canopy wall-attachment height and front-edge height
exact canopy post count, section, spacing and positions

validation.note: Identity checks confirm that a mapped model preserved a binding number. They are not survey tolerances. A hand-sketch digit is either the digit written or a misread, not 14000 ± 1 as a measured length.

policy_checks.fails_if: a mapper treats the shell-hugging hints as zero-thickness rooms

reconstruction_guidance.rule: Build only source_kind dimensioned or derived. Do not invent wall height, thickness, pitch, overhang, or opening size. Do not treat sketch axes as compass directions. A null in unknowns must still be null after mapping.
reconstruction_guidance.target_software_policy: A target may map binding objects to native BIM objects, generic solids, or IFC. It must preserve identifiers, source_kind, nulls, relationships, and these checks. Proportional hints are not objects.

changes_from_0_1: Axes are sketch-right and sketch-down. The north-west origin is withdrawn.
A001 is withdrawn. The vertical 14.0 m is dimensioned.
x = 8000 is derived from 14.0 m minus 6 m, not estimated. The right bedroom and the living wing are binding cells on that line.
4500 mm and 3000 mm are quarantined as proportional_hints and removed from the partitions.
The wall between the right bedroom and living is added as IP_DERIVED_02. v0.1 left that shared edge with no partition and no opening.
D_EXT_01's east-side location is withdrawn. The corner swing and the gable-end door are separate unresolved openings.
Windows record a host edge where the plan shows ticks. Counts and sizes stay null.
The roof reading is a primary gable plus a lower wing roof. Overhang is present and unmeasured.
The WTRD. note and the kitchen rectangle are kept as unresolved marks.
Units are stated per quantity. Confidence no longer promotes a value into the shell.
Identity checks are labelled as preservation checks, not survey accuracy.

purpose.task: Reconstruct the design intent encoded in the Building 001 sketch.
success: Preserve every exact dimension and arithmetic consequence.
Preserve room identities and topological relations visible in the plan.
Use the perspective to constrain vertical form and cross-view object identity.
Keep unsupported values explicit as approximate, ambiguous, or unknown.
Allow multiple AIs/tools to produce materially equivalent concept geometry from the same file.
Never promote visualization guesses into authoritative design facts.

constraints.rule: reentrant_x_mm == overall_width_mm - projecting_wing_width_mm == 8000 while the strokes remain colinear
Exact/derived values may not be changed by approximate/proportional interpretation.
Unknown values remain null in the authoritative layer.
Plan and perspective cross-constrain object identity; neither view may be interpreted in isolation when a correspondence exists.
Canopy/porch is covered exterior space and must not be added to the enclosed footprint area.

ambiguities.resolution: Keep authoritative footprint as abstract stroke boundary. Concept profile uses outside boundary with inward wall thickness.

ambiguities.rule: Do not convert into a room, wardrobe, or rename.
Do not convert into a bench, island, or room.
Do not assign perspective windows to plan hosts without a reliable correspondence.

acceptance_invariants: Overall sketch extents are 14000 x 14000 mm.
Projecting living wing remains 6000 mm wide and 8000 mm deep.
The projecting wing occupies the right side of the sketch and begins at x=8000 mm.
RM_BED_02 is the 6000 x 6000 mm upper-right cell.
RM_LIVING_01 is the 6000 x 8000 mm projecting wing.
The perspective reads as one dominant gable over the upper bar plus a lower gable over the projecting wing.
The re-entrant/open area is exterior, with a low canopy/porch roof supported by posts.
Canopy and posts do not alter the enclosed footprint.
No approximate value overrides exact or derived evidence.
All output carries provenance and declares concept vs authoritative geometry.

required_resolution.for_concept_reconstruction: No additional human input required if concept assumptions are visibly tagged.
for_exact_architectural_model: wall reference line and wall thickness
exact partition positions for left bedroom / bath / kitchen
window counts, sizes and exact locations
canopy depth, heights and exact post positions
required_resolution.for_construction: Blocked until site/context, regulation, structure, systems, assemblies, and all unresolved geometry are professionally resolved.

limitations: opening positions not safely transferable to plan without correspondence

covered_exterior_spaces.name: Covered exterior porch / canopy zone
covered_exterior_spaces.location: re-entrant/open area below E05 and left of the projecting living wing

low roof projects from the main bar over an exterior area
vertical supports are visible beneath the low roof

cross_view_correspondence.plan_evidence: open re-entrant area adjacent to E05
cross_view_correspondence.perspective_evidence: low roof plane beneath main eave
cross_view_correspondence.effect: The re-entrant area remains exterior but is partly covered.

cross_view_correspondence.perspective_evidence: lower gable volume intersecting dominant upper-bar roof

concept_build_profile.rule: Dimensions override proportion. Proportion fills the gaps. User clarification resolves contradictions.

evidence.value: dominant primary gable + lower projecting-wing roof
low canopy roof over re-entrant exterior area

evidence.source: plan small squares + perspective vertical supports

evidence.maps_to: wall thickness/height, roof pitch, exact openings, materials, structure

authoritative_only.purpose: Build only exact/derived geometry and semantic markers.
geometry: known x=8000 and y=6000 partition/topology lines

concept_mass_model.purpose: Produce a repeatable 3D concept matching the latest interpreted sketch.
requirements: Do not cut unresolved openings by default.
Include primary roof, lower living-wing roof, low canopy, and posts.
Preserve exact outer extents and footprint area.

detailed_visualization.purpose: Populate a visually rich but explicitly non-authoritative model.
detailed_visualization.warning: All opening dimensions/locations in this mode are visualization guesses.

target_neutrality.rule: Target software may change representation, never evidence status or binding geometry.

generation_sequence: Create authoritative footprint and verify extents/area.
Create slab/walls only if selected mode supplies thickness/height assumptions.
Create exact/derived partition topology, then approximate partitions if allowed.
Create dominant upper-bar gable and lower projecting-wing gable if concept mode.
Create covered exterior canopy and support posts if concept mode.
Create opening markers; cut openings only if selected mode explicitly allows visualization guesses or later human-confirmed geometry.
Run all acceptance and geometry checks.
Export a provenance manifest alongside the model.
failure_policy: If an exact dimension conflicts with proportion, exact dimension wins.
If two exact facts conflict, stop and request human resolution.
If topology is ambiguous and materially affects requested output, preserve alternatives or ask the human.
If ambiguity is non-material to a concept mass model, continue only with an explicit assumption record.
Never mutate the 14m x 14m bounding extents to make roofs or rooms easier to fit.

EXT_PORCH_01 is exterior and not part of 132 m2 enclosed stroke footprint
canopy attaches to E05 and posts support canopy

concept_profile_checks.check: primary roof ridge height > projecting-wing roof ridge height under default concept assumptions
canopy front edge height < canopy wall attachment height
all concept posts lie in re-entrant exterior zone
no approximate opening is cut in default concept_mass_model

governance_checks.check: no approximate value overwrites exact/derived fields
export manifest declares build mode and assumption IDs
